name: KSL
recent: KSL 完成末期股息的股息再投资计划，发行 35,638,678 股新股并于 9 月 7 日上市，股本扩大至约 11.29 亿股。同时，Ku 家族通过家族架构整合股权后，股东获 SC 豁免强制全面收购。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收与净利均较上季增长。
notable: 完成末期股息股息再投资计划，发行 35,638,678 股新股，于 2026 年 9 月 7 日上市。
股东获 SC 豁免因 Ku 家族整合股权而触发的强制全面收购。
risks: 股息再投资计划发行新股导致股本扩大，可能摊薄每股权益。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 380.968 百万，净利 MYR 115.732 百万，净利率 30.4%；营收环比增 32.7%，净利环比增 77.2%，营收同比增 4.5%，净利同比增 2.4%。

recent_en: KSL completed the dividend reinvestment plan for its final dividend, issuing 35,638,678 new shares listed on 7 September, enlarging share capital to about 1.129 billion shares. Meanwhile, shareholders received an SC exemption from a mandatory general offer after the Ku family consolidated stakes under a family structure. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue and net profit both rose quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Completed the dividend reinvestment plan for the final dividend, issuing 35,638,678 new shares listed on 7 September 2026.
Shareholders received an SC exemption from the mandatory general offer triggered by the Ku family's consolidation of stakes.
risks_en: The dividend reinvestment plan's new share issuance enlarged the share base and may dilute per-share interests.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 380.968 million and net profit MYR 115.732 million, with a net margin of 30.4%; revenue rose 32.7% QoQ and net profit 77.2% QoQ, while revenue grew 4.5% YoY and net profit 2.4% YoY.
